about: The Workbench icons of the MightyMike drawer: python3 AMICRADLE/scripts/ports/port_icons.py amiga/icons/icons.json --out amiga/icons (DalsinAI/amicradle). The art (art/mightymike.png) is upstream's packaging/MightyMike128.png, under the game's own terms. MightyMike-drawer.info is the drawer's own icon, MightyMike.info beside the drawer; it has its own name here so as not to meet the program's MightyMike.info. ReadMe.info is also copied for Controls, Licence.txt and Licences.txt; Data.info is the Data and User drawers' icon.
